panels.description: All test result rows captured in the selected time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(tr.id) AS total_tests_run FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0));

panels.title: Total Tests Run

panels.description: Passing test results in the selected time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_passed FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0));

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS total_hosts FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0));

panels.title: Total Hosts

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_failed FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0));

panels.description: Passing and skipped results divided by all recorded results in the window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status IN ('pass', 'skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(tr.id), 0), 0) AS pass_rate FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0));

panels.title: Pass Rate

panels.description: Average per-test execution time for all recorded results in the window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tr.duration_ms), 0), 0) AS avg_duration_ms FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0));

panels.title: Avg Duration

panels.description: Daily execution volume split by result status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at)) AS time, LOWER(tr.status) AS metric, COUNT(tr.id) AS value FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at) BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0)) GROUP BY r.run_id, tr.status, r.finished_at, r.started_at ORDER BY COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at);

panels.title: Execution Trend

panels.description: Overall mix of result states in the selected time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pass, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fail, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'xfail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS xfail, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'xpass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS xpass FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0));

panels.title: Status Distribution

panels.description: Hosts with the highest concentration of fail and error results.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.host_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fail_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error_count FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0)) GROUP BY h.id, h.host_name HAVING fail_count > 0 OR error_count > 0 ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status IN ('fail', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(tr.id), 0)) DESC, fail_count DESC, error_count DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Most Impacted Hosts

panels.description: Latest runs with outcome, host footprint, and pass rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.run_id, r.trigger_source, DATE_FORMAT(r.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS started_at, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at, COUNT(tr.id) AS total_tests, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS errored, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS hosts, ROUND(100 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status IN ('pass', 'skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(tr.id), 0), 1) AS pass_rate_pct FROM test_runs r LEFT JOIN test_results tr ON tr.run_id = r.run_id LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND ('${trigger_source:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.trigger_source, '${trigger_source:csv}') > 0) AND ('${cluster:csv}' = '' OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all' OR tr.id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_markers trm WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND FIND_IN_SET(trm.marker_value, '${cluster:csv}') > 0)) GROUP BY r.run_id, r.trigger_source, r.started_at, r.finished_at ORDER BY r.started_at DESC LIMIT 12;
